drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Attached please find our initial markup of the Confidential Settlement Agreement. We have inserted a proposed Settlement Amount of USD 38,000,000, payable within ten business days after execution and receipt of wire instructions, together with standard provisions addressing dismissal, confidentiality carve-outs, authority, and no admission.

We believe this is a practical framework for promptly resolving the matter and welcome your comments.

Best regards,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff a total settlement amount of USD 38,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds within ten (10) business days after the later of: (a) full execution of this Agreement; and (b) Defendant’s receipt of written wire instructions and a properly completed IRS Form W-9 or applicable tax form from Plaintiff.
edits.name: Payment amount and timing

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its predecessors, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives, releases and forever discharges Defendant and its predecessors, successors, assigns, parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, and representatives from all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, damages, costs, and expenses, whether known or unknown, asserted or unasserted, arising out of or relating to the matters alleged or that could have been alleged in the action through the Effective Date.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The existence and terms of this settlement are confidential and shall not be disclosed by either party except: (a) to the party’s attorneys, accountants, auditors, insurers, tax advisors, officers, directors, employees, and other representatives who have a need to know and are informed of the confidential nature of the information; (b) as required by law, regulation, court order, subpoena, or applicable reporting obligation; (c) to enforce this Agreement; or (d) by written agreement of the parties. If a party receives compulsory process seeking disclosure, it shall, to the extent legally permitted, provide prompt written notice to the other party and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.
edits.name: Confidentiality with carve-outs

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement, the payment of the Settlement Amount, and any related negotiations are a compromise of disputed claims and are not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, wrongdoing, fault, or the validity of any claim or defense by any party, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: No admission

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve fully and finally all claims, disputes, and controversies between them arising out of or relating to the action and the matters alleged therein, without admission of liability and subject to the terms set forth below.
edits.name: Recitals

edits.text: 5. DISMISSAL. Within three (3) business days after Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff shall file, or cause to be filed, a stipulation of dismissal with prejudice of the action, with each party to bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs except as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement.
edits.name: Dismissal

edits.text: 6. AUTHORITY. Each person executing this Agreement represents and warrants that they have full authority to bind the party on whose behalf they sign, and each party represents that it has not assigned or transferred any released claim.
edits.name: Authority

edits.text: 7. TAXES. Plaintiff shall be solely responsible for any taxes, interest, penalties, reporting, or withholding obligations arising from its receipt of the Settlement Amount, and Defendant makes no representation regarding the tax treatment of any payment under this Agreement.
edits.name: Taxes

edits.text: 8. ENTIRE AGREEMENT; COUNTERPARTS. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions or understandings. It may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties and may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which shall be deemed an original.
edits.name: Entire agreement and counterparts

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Thank you for your note. Defendant cannot agree to USD 62,000,000. In the interest of avoiding further litigation expense and reaching prompt finality, Defendant is prepared to revise the settlement amount to USD 41,500,000, with payment within five business days after full execution and receipt of complete wire/tax documentation.

We have also completed the draft by adding Sections 4–7 for your review. As reflected in the draft, dismissal would follow cleared funds, and the agreement remains without admission of liability.

Please let us know if Plaintiff can accept these terms so we can move quickly to execution.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff a total settlement amount of USD 41,500,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds within five (5) business days after the later of: (a) full execution of this Agreement; and (b) Defendant’s receipt of written wire instructions and a properly completed IRS Form W-9 or applicable tax form from Plaintiff.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 4. DISMISSAL. Within three (3) business days after Plaintiff’s counsel confirms receipt of cleared funds comprising the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff shall file, or cause to be filed, a dismissal with prejudice of the action, with each party to bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs except as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement. The parties shall cooperate reasonably in preparing and filing any papers necessary to effectuate such dismissal.
edits.name: Dismissal

edits.text: 5. NO ADMISSION OF LIABILITY. This Agreement is entered into solely for the purpose of compromising disputed claims. Neither this Agreement, nor any payment or performance under it, constitutes or shall be construed as an admission of liability, wrongdoing, fault, or violation of law by Defendant, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: No Admission of Liability

edits.text: 6. AUTHORITY; REPRESENTATIONS. Each party represents and warrants that it has full authority to enter into this Agreement, that the person signing on its behalf is duly authorized to do so, and that it has not assigned or transferred any claim released by this Agreement. Plaintiff further represents that it is solely responsible for any taxes, liens, claims, allocations, or reporting obligations arising from or relating to receipt of the Settlement Amount, and Defendant makes no representation regarding the tax treatment of the Settlement Amount.
edits.name: Authority; Representations

edits.text: 7. GOVERNING LAW; ENFORCEMENT. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law rules that would require application of another jurisdiction’s law. The court in which the action is pending shall retain jurisdiction to enforce this Agreement, or, if it lacks jurisdiction, either party may bring an action to enforce this Agreement in any court of competent jurisdiction. In any enforcement proceeding, the prevailing party may recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs.
edits.name: Governing Law; Enforcement

edits.text: 8. ENTIRE AGREEMENT; COUNTERPARTS. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions or understandings. It may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties and may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which shall be deemed an original.
edits.name: Entire Agreement; Counterparts
